content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your recent load is moderate: 3.5 hours and 140 Load across two rides last week. Fitness is 55, fatigue 48, and form +7; resting HR and HRV are stable, so intensity is reasonable if that remains true by Saturday.

**Saturday — Sweet spot, ~75min**  
Warmup: 15min progressive Z1–Z2 (50–70% FTP)  
Main: 3×12min sweet spot (88–94% FTP), 4min easy at 50–55% between  
Cooldown: 10min Z1 (<55% FTP)  
Estimated intensity: ~0.80  
Estimated Load: 70–80  
Why: Adds productive sustained work after last week’s easier endurance/tempo riding.

**Sunday — Endurance, 2hr**  
Warmup: 10min at 50–65% FTP  
Main: 100min steady Z2 (60–72% FTP), conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated intensity: ~0.68  
Estimated Load: 85–100  
Why: Builds aerobic volume without turning the weekend into an excessive fatigue spike.

If form falls below -30, resting HR is elevated, or your legs feel unusually heavy, replace Saturday’s intervals with 45–60min easy Z1–Z2.
